scripts.dev:api: cd api && if command -v air >/dev/null; then air; else go run .; fi; exit 1
scripts.build: bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.check: cd api && go vet ./... && cd .. && bun run --cwd frontend check
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun test scripts/setup.test.ts
scripts.generate:go: cd api && sqlc generate && oapi-codegen -config oapi-codegen.yaml openapi.yaml
scripts.generate: bun run generate:go && bun run generate:api
